question: Who must be the giver of liberation if selves and bonds cannot remove bondage?
premises: Neither selves nor bonds can effect liberation
Shiva alone is the remover of bondage
When a visible cause is established, an unseen cause need not be assumed
inference: Therefore Shiva alone is the giver of liberation to individual selves
plain_english: Since Shiva alone is the remover of bondage, he alone is the giver of liberation to souls; when this is seen, there is no need to assume an unseen cause.
